name: Northshire class trainers take in their class letter quests, part B (#6225)
contract: Report #6225: the CoA class trainers in Northshire Abbey cannot be interacted with, so the class letter quests from Marshal McBride cannot be handed in.

creature_questender names each trainer as the ender of its class letter quest; this part covers Patal the Mad (50283), Norman Goldshire (50287), Chaplain Nysoni (50286), Troes the Remover (50289), Amanda the Reaver (50295), Doctor Yara (502960), Deacon Frost (50325).
Each trainer template carries npcflag 51 (gossip, quest giver, trainer); a fixture keeps its template data, so it is a quest giver exactly when the shipped template is.
Each character of the quest's class holds its completed letter quest and must be able to hand it in to its own trainer (quest status 6, rewarded).
